## Summary

Describe the behavior and why the change is needed.

## Risk and evidence

- [ ] `make ci` / `.\scripts\dev.ps1 ci` passes
- [ ] Contract, safety, and failure-path tests were added or updated
- [ ] IAM and PII impact were reviewed
- [ ] Cost/latency/retry impact was reviewed
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs reflect architectural changes
- [ ] No secret, credential, personal data, or fabricated result is included

## Deployment / rollback

State the deployment prerequisites, migration implications, and rollback path. Write `none` only when
the change truly has no runtime impact.
